info.title: VA disability compensation recipients by county and combined rating: data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
VA disability compensation recipients by county and combined rating: Veterans receiving VA disability compensation in every U.S. county on September 30, 2025 (fiscal year 2025), from the Department of Veterans Affairs county file on data.va.gov: the total and the count in each combined service-connected rating band (0 to 20%, 30 to 40%, 50 to 60%, 70 to 90% and 100%), by age group (17 to 44, 45 to 64, 65 and over) and by sex, with the same county's total and 100% count a year earlier. One record per county (3,144, in the 50 states and DC), per state and DC (the sum of its counties), for Puerto Rico, for the other territories, for veterans paid abroad, for unknown addresses and for the US. Cells VA suppressed to protect privacy are left empty and marked suppressed, never estimated.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
